status: initial design fixed before new pilot; learned policies and final counts saved before confirmation
stages: freeze sample-only rule and development-trained rate policies
independent asymmetry confirmation and code/length transfer

pilot.reference_family: existing nested PEG, seed11, row count independently calibrated at symmetric channels for FER closest to 10%

inputs: sample basis difference / estimated standard error
automatic_rule.selection: maximize paired development success gain over lambda=0 after subtracting 1.96 paired standard errors; require positive lower bound; deterministic ties choose smaller lambda; empty bins use zero

families: Gallager balanced partitions, column weight3; exactly regular where divisibility permits
published BSC-optimized irregular variable-degree profiles with bounded-search PEG realization
codes.optimized_profile_source: Elkouss et al. arXiv:0901.2140 Table I; edge-to-node conversion explicitly recorded
codes.storage: CSR edges, no silent padding; row counts charged conservatively

pipeline_development.policy: ridge logistic FER prediction from observable sample features, row fraction and block length; same features, code pool, tuning budget and learning procedure for pooled and selected-prior decoders; maximize predicted verified reconciliation yield; never select on test outcomes

transfer.frames_per_matrix: pilot variance calculation for 0.5 percentage-point yield effect, 80% nominal conditional power; round to100, floor500, cap2000; code-to-code uncertainty reported separately

fixed_total.n: N-s; generate matrices at exact length, no padded bits

physical.transition_prior: Jeffreys-smoothed P(B|A,basis), converted to P(error|Bob bit,basis) with uniform Alice prior
physical.entropy: use actual H(A|B,Z) and H(A|B) for bit-asymmetric channels

device_cases: fixed noisy Eve, legitimate operations scaled
diagnostics.main_robustness_case: ideal Eve; fixed noisy Eve and all-scaled mechanisms and selected-cell controls separately
diagnostics.target: residual QBER at zero controllable legitimate noise; report ideal r/4 separately where unequal
stress: 50% attack-fraction ramp during acquisitions, failure-mode only
diagnostics.reliability_map: MAE <=1pp and empirical coverage >=90%; descriptive operational thresholds, not a universal guarantee

statistics.pairing: same raw frame, sample and matrix; policies chosen before decode
statistics.matrix_unit: five independent libraries per family/length; t4 intervals on paired matrix means and within-matrix intervals separately
statistics.main_75_cells: paired counts, Wilson FER, bootstrap paired yield; Holm exact McNemar across75 cells per method

triple_check: manuscript/figures/package consistency and PDF visual inspection
reproducibility.runtime: amortized wall time, warmed JIT, reported separately from deterministic science arrays
